tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i nyams len gyi rim pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// swa sti/ bde ldan pad+mo'i nags rum nas// 'chi med bung ba 'od dpag med// der 'dir thugs rje'i 'phur lding gis// byon la phan bde'i sbrang rtsi stsol// bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas tshe'i dngos grub bsgrub par 'dod pas tho rangs bya kha ta'i skad ma bsgrags pa'i dus la sogs par bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang la/ de'i steng du bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing gsal la dwangs pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang*/ 'dzum zhing zhi ba yid du 'ong ba'i zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na bai ḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa'i ral pa phyed thor cog gi tshul du spyi bor bcings shing*/ lhag ma lan bur gyur pas zhabs kyi rting pa'i bar du sleb pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ lhab lhub kyis brgyan pa/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs nas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas mchod cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das la mos gus drag po dung pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe/ sa ra he/ sha ra

sa ra ha/ ka ra re/ shwa ra re hūm̐/ zer ba'ang snang*/ re/ ka ra re hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de rjes rang gi sna bug nas rlung ro lan gsum bus/ de rjes sna bug g.yon nas rlung cung zad phyir bus pa'i tshe/ rang gi sna rtse nas rlung spos reng gi du ba lta bu sngo bun ne song ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gi lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba'i nang du song bas/ 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rlung de la 'khris pa'i tshul du skya nar gyis babs pa/ rang gi khas rngub pa'i tshul du byas pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po de kha nas mar chil gyis zhugs/ lus thams cad mer gyis gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sangs kyis dag 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams nas rlung bum pa can ci thub 'dzin/ de ltar lan lnga'am/ bcu'am/ bco lnga'am/ nyi shu nas brgya yi bar ci 'grub bya/ rjes dmigs pa sngar ltar byed cing*/ ngag tu/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti swā hā/ zhes brgya stong la sogs pa bzla/ yang sngar bzhin mchod bstod byas pas/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das 'od zer dmar po'i tshul du zhu ste rang la thim pas bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med par lam gyis gyur pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po la gzungs ring gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros lus thams cad gang bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs gzungs ring nyer gcig bzla/ dge ba 'di yis myur du nas/ sa la 'god par shog ces sogs bsngo ba smon lam bya/ 'di la brten nas tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma byed par 'dod pas/ lo gsar zla ba sogs kyi yar ngo'i tshes gcig sogs gza' skar gang bzang nas zhag bdun gyi bar la mtshams shin tu dam par bcad/ zas rdor dkar dang gung tshigs ma yol bar byed/

zhog re bzhin khrus bya zhing*/ grub na gso sbyong gi sdom pa blang zhing tsha bzhes yan la thun gcig tsha bzhes grol nas gung tshigs yan la thun gcig bya/ thun re la nyams su len tshul sngar ltar bya zhing*/ de yang rlung sbyor dang sngags spel mar byed pa yin pas/ rlung lnga bcu nas brgya man ci rigs/ sngags stong nas khri man ci 'grub bzla/ gzungs ring yang thun re la nyer gcig nas brgya'i bar ci 'grub bzla/ mthar bsngo ba smon lam sogs sngar ltar mtshungs/ nyi ma phyed man sher snying sogs/ zlog pa dang srung 'khor kho na la 'bad/ nub mo gnyid du 'gro khar nub phyogs bde ba can la sngas gtad de seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal/ rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gnyid log pas/ rmi lam du sku mthong ba/ gsung thos pa la sogs dang*/ nyi zla 'char ba/ sgra gcan las grol ba/ nam langs pa dang*/ lhung bzed dang bum pa sogs snod dkar gsum gyis gang ba/ sāts+tsha dkar pos lung pa khengs pa sogs dge ba'i ltas du ma dang khyad par tshe lo 'di tsam thub ces pa'i lung bstan nges pa can dang*/ srog chags/ phreng ba/ shing thog zan ril/ sba smyug tshigs can/ dpe shog nya ga la sogs pa'i tshe 'di tsam thub pa'i grangs lung ston pa'i brda'i rnam pa mtha' yas pa zhig 'ong bas/ de dag shin tu gsang bar bya/ gal te lung bstan ma byung na/ slar yang zhag bdun bskyar bas nges par 'byung ba yin no// de ltar zhag bdun ma'i dus dang*/ rgyun gyi nyams len gyi tshe yang tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i smra bcad dam po dang the tshom med pa'i yid ches khyad par can gyi sgo nas 'bad rtsol gyis nyams su blangs pas/ ji skad bshad pa bzhin 'byung ba ni nyams su myong bas grub pa yin no// 'phags yul grub dbang pad+ma'i ngang tshul gang*// gangs can 'di na rong ston chos kyi rje// rje btsun dam pa'i thugs bcud bdud rtsi'i rgyun// rgyun chad med par bla ma'i drin las thob// gang 'dir ris med bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe// nor 'dzin skyong ba ngag dbang mtshan can gyi// rgyun gyi nyams bzhes tshul du bkod pa ni// shākya'i btsun pa blo gsal ming can no// ā yuḥpuṇ+ye war+dha ku ru maṅga laṃ bha ban+tu//

༈ /tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i brgyud 'debs dngos grub mchog stsol ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo rat+na gu ru/ dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan tshe dpag med// rgyal bas rjes bzung grub pa'i rgyal mo'i zhabs// rnal 'byor kun gyi gtsug rgyan te phu par// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chos kyi rje// thugs kyi sras mchog nam mkha' dpal ldan pa// kun spangs chos rje rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi= /de ltar khyed la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// dus min 'chi ba'i dgra las rnam rgyal te// phun tshogs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i nye brgyud kyi bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang yul gtsang stod kyi btsun pa blo gsal gyis snyug ri khang bzang gi dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam lnga pa'i me tog mdangs can gyi gnas su sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni mgon po 'od zer gyis bgyis pa'o// ༈ /kha skong ni/ grub pa'i dbang phyug kun spangs chos rje la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi= /rgyal ba kun dngos tshar chen chos kyi rje// 'jam dpal rdo rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dang*// mkhas grub dbang po bslab gsum rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba= /dus min 'chi ba las rgyal dbang phyug mtshan// tshe dpag med dngos khyab bdag zhwa lu pa// mgon des rjes bzung ngag gi dbang phyug la// gsol ba= /ces pa'i kha skong 'di yang lha btsun ngag gi dbang phyug gis bris pa'o// de'i kha skong ni// slob bshad bstan pa'i nyi ma rmor chen rje// gdams pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag gnas gsar ba// 'chi med mchog brnyes 'jam dpal rdo rje la// gsol ba= /mkhas grub chen po kun dga' dpal bzang po// gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin kun dga' 'jam dpal dang*// brgyud srol kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe yi dngos grub stsol// ces pa'ang yongs 'dzin dam pa rnam pa bzhi las gdam zab 'di nyid kyi bka' drin thob pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa dge/

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
